Job Description: At Minoh, we turn bold ideas into visual experiences that leave a lasting impression. We specialize in all types of custom signage—from wayfinding systems and A\-frames to large\-format billboards, vehicle wraps, window graphics, and full installation services. No matter the scale or complexity, our team brings together creativity, craftsmanship, and technical precision to deliver signage that stands out.

We believe that great work starts with great people—and a great team. That’s why we’re excited to welcome an enthusiastic and detail\-oriented Graphic Designer with a strong background in pre\-press production, project coordination, and client communication.

This is a key role for someone who is versatile, organized, and ready to take the lead on custom signage projects from concept to completion.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Prepare design files, artwork, and technical drawings for production
* Design custom visuals using Photoshop, Illustrator, and InDesign
* Lead projects from initial concept through to final delivery
* Communicate directly with clients to understand needs, share updates, and provide creative solutions
* Coordinate with team members—including production, installation, and design—to keep projects on track
* Maintain clear timelines, meet deadlines, and ensure high\-quality standards
* Provide direction and support to other team members when needed
* Keep accurate records and complete all project documentation
* Foster a safe, organized, and collaborative work environment
* Follow all company procedures and health \& safety guidelines

**Qualifications:**

* 5\+ years of experience in graphic design, preferably in signage or a related industry
* Experience managing projects and working directly with clients
* Strong proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign)
* A team player who can also take the lead when required
* Great time management and problem\-solving abilities
* Degree/Diploma Graphic Design
* Able to work in a team environment and individually

Schedule:

* Monday to Friday

Ability to commute/relocate:

* Etobicoke, ON: reliably commute or plan to relocate before starting work (required)

Job Type: Full\-time

Experience:

* Graphic Design: 5 years (required)
* Sign manufacturing and setting up print files: 5 years (required)

Education: University/College

Additional Information

* Location: This is an on\-site position at our production facility. Remote work options are not available for this role.
* Work Environment: Fast\-paced, supportive, and highly collaborative, where creative problem\-solving and technical excellence are celebrated.

**Call\-To\-Action**

* If you're ready to unleash your creativity in an exciting environment, we want to hear from you! Apply now and let’s create something amazing together!

Job Type: Full\-time

Pay: $20\.00\-$25\.00 per hour

Benefits:

* Dental care
* On\-site parking
* Vision care

Ability to commute/relocate:

* Etobicoke, ON M8W 3R1: reliably commute or plan to relocate before starting work (preferred)

Education:

* AEC / DEP or Skilled Trade Certificate (preferred)

Experience:

* graphic design in signage: 5 years (required)

Work Location: In person
